items.title: CVE-2026-111943: Compromised Intermediate Certificate Authority
items.summary: A critical vulnerability has been identified in an intermediate certificate authority, potentially allowing attackers to impersonate trusted entities. Developers and engineers should assess their systems for exposure and apply necessary mitigations to safeguard against potential exploitation.

items.title: Faster than earcut: triangulating 3.7M map polygons in 489 ms
items.summary: A new algorithm has been developed that can triangulate 3.7 million map polygons in just 489 milliseconds, outperforming existing solutions. This advancement could significantly enhance the performance of web applications that rely on complex geographical data.

items.title: WorldTUI: I trained a 360M model to pretend to be a terminal
items.summary: A new AI model, WorldTUI, has been trained to simulate terminal interactions, showcasing the potential for AI to enhance user interfaces in command-line environments. This development could inspire new tools and applications that leverage AI for improved user experience in technical workflows.

items.title: Security Disclosure
items.summary: A recent security disclosure highlights critical vulnerabilities that could impact various applications and services. Developers should review the disclosed issues and apply necessary patches to ensure their systems remain secure.

items.title: Compromised LiteLLM 1.107.0 on PyPI Installs a Credential Stealer and Backdoor
items.summary: The LiteLLM package on PyPI has been compromised, leading to the installation of a credential stealer and backdoor on affected systems. Developers using this package should immediately remove it and audit their environments for potential breaches.
